描述_EN: arrowhead，late Spring and Autumn period (770-476 BC)，elder7.5centimetre，surname Kuan2.2centimetre，repetition0.0185kg。　　此arrowhead锐锋，spread both wings，The wing tips are tapered.。　　Bronze arrowheads were first seen in the Erlitou culture site，It's one of the earliest bronze weapons in China，It was used in large quantities in the early Shang Dynasty。Western Zhou period visible with collared biplane arrowheads，Some of the wings are skeletonized.。Common forms of the Spring and Autumn period had winged and wingless forms,The wings of the wing-shaped arrowheads have a tendency to be cut back.。
描述_ZN: Yagyu pot, 34.6 cm in height, 24.5 cm in width, weighing 6.49 kg. The pot is flat and rounded, with a lavish mouth, a bunched neck, double pierced ears, a pendulous belly, and a rounded foot. From the mouth to the foot, there are six layers of decoration: the first, third, and fifth layers are decorated with animal-face motifs, the second, fourth, and sixth layers are decorated with kui-elephant motifs, and the two ears are decorated with animal-face motifs. The whole body is decorated with a thunder pattern as the ground pattern, and the overall decoration is fine and gorgeous.　　The inscription "Yah" is cast on the bottom of the pot, and "Yah" is the clan name of the maker of the vessel.
